newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua stevedores to strike one hour.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua stevedores to strike one hour.

text.p: Stevedores at Brazil's key Paranagua port will go on strike for one hour Friday at 1300 local/1800 GMT, but grain loading at the port's export terminal will continue uninterrupted, a union official said.
"We will go on strike for one hour tomorrow in solidarity with the striking stevedores at the port of Santos," a spokesman for the Paranagua Stevedores' Union said.
He said grain loading at the port's export terminal would not be affected by the stoppage and would continue throughout the day.

Stevedores at Santos have been on strike since Wednesday over a ruling which allows company workers from steel mill Companhia Siderurgica Paulista (Cosipa) to operate Cosipa's private terminal at the port.
The strike is scheduled to spread to the national level Friday.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
